<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/products/{prod}/applicable_plans/{plan}"}
#docs
`source` is `attached` (an explicit link), `differential` (implied by a plan-specific price) or `all` (the add-on applies to every plan).

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `prod` | `string` | **yes** | The product's id (a slug id, e.g. `pro`). |
| `plan` | `string` | **yes** | The id of the plan product (a slug id, e.g. `pro`). |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `item` | `string` | The attached add-on or charge product |
| `plan` | `string` | The plan's product id (a slug id, e.g. `pro`). |
| `kind` | `string` | The attached item's kind. One of `addon`, `charge`. |
| `active` | `boolean` | True if the attached item is active. |
| `source` | `string` | Whether the item is attached directly or through a differential price. One of `attached`, `differential`, `all`. |
| `applicability` | `string` | How the plan treats the item: mandatory, recommended or optional. One of `mandatory`, `recommended`, `optional`. |
| `charge_on_event` | `string` | The event that charges the item. |
| `charge_once` | `boolean` | True if the item is charged once instead of every period. |
| `default_quantity` | `integer` | The quantity used when none is given. |
| `billing_cycles` | `integer` | How many billing cycles the item is charged for. |
| `min_quantity` | `integer` | Portal-only minimum. |
| `max_quantity` | `integer` | Portal-only maximum. |
| `quantity_step` | `integer` | Portal-only quantity step. |
| `customer_can_change_quantity` | `boolean` | Whether customers can change the quantity in the portal. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | No such plan, or the item does not apply to it |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/products/pro/applicable_plans/pro-monthly-usd" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
